name: Train
summary: An engine and a carriage, 69 cm end to end.
text:
The longest piece in the range: an engine and a carriage, painted red, with the windows and the wheels lit.

It suits a long shelf or a windowsill. The carriage can carry an engraved name.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
